title_zh: 維斯帕拉德 第 10 章
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
(zôt,) âyese ýeshti arezahibyô savahibyô
fradadhafshubyô vîdadhafshubyô vouru-bareshtibyô
vouru-jareshtibyô aheca karshvanê ýat hvanirathahe.
segments.en:
I desire to approach the Arezahi with my praise, and the
Sawahi, and Fradadhafshu, and Widadhafshu, and Wouru-bareshti,
and Wourujareshti, and this Karshwar which is Xwaniratha. 2.
And I desire to approach the stone mortar with my praise, and
the iron mortar, and the cup that holds the Zaothra, and the hair
(which stays the spilling), and Thy Baresman spread with sanctity.
And I desire to approach the Ahuna-vairya [ Ahunwar ] with my praise, and
the ritual prayers beside Ahuna, and the standing offices of the
Mazdayasnian Faith. 1. This section follows Y. 22.
segments.zh:
我渴望以我的讚頌親近阿雷扎希，以及
薩瓦希，以及弗拉達達夫舒，以及維達達夫舒，以及沃烏魯-巴雷什蒂，
以及沃烏魯賈雷什蒂，以及這作為赫瓦尼拉薩的卡爾什瓦爾。2.
且我渴望以我的讚頌親近石臼，以及
鐵臼，以及盛放扎奧特拉的杯，以及那毛髮
（用以防止溢出者），以及祢以神聖鋪展的巴爾斯曼。
我願以讚美接近阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞〔阿洪瓦爾〕，以及
阿胡納之旁的儀式祈禱，以及
馬茲達信仰的常規儀禮。1. 本節接續雅斯納 22。

segments.orig:
âyese ýeshti asmanaêibya hâvanaêibya
ayanghaênaêibya hâvanaêibya tashtâi
zaothrô-barenâi varesâi haomô-angharezânâi
tavaca baresmanô ashaya frastaretahe, âyese ýeshti
ahunahe vairyehe anahunâca ratushca stitâtasca daênayå
mâzdayasnôish, âyese ýeshti ashâunãm
fravashinãm > mraotû!!
segments.en:
The varesa consists (as used at present) of three, five, or seven 
 hairs from the tail of a white bull, which are tied to a gold, silver, 
 copper, or brass ring. This can be used as long as the bull lives, 
 but as often as it is used it must be reconsecrated. (Haug.)
segments.zh: varesa 由（現時所用）由三、五或七根白公牛尾髮組成，這些髮繫於金、銀、銅或黃銅環上。這只要公牛活著就可以使用，但每次使用後必須重新祝聖。（Haug。）
